flags.description: A 2024 BBC World Service investigation found children as young as five picking jasmine overnight for as little as $1/day on Egyptian farms supplying fragrance suppliers used by L'Oréal; L'Oréal acknowledged certain supplier practices don't meet its commitments.

Animal-rights groups do not recognize L'Oréal as cruelty-free because it continues to sell finished cosmetics in mainland China, where regulators have required animal testing for certain product categories.
